about: Every sound in the game, in one place: what it is, which mix bus it plays on, how loud, its takes (variations), its files, and where each file came from with its licence. src/audio/AudioService.js plays from it, scripts/assets/build-assets.mjs encodes from it, CREDITS.md and the in-game credits are generated from it (node scripts/assets/build-credits.mjs), and tests/audio-licences.test.js checks it. Fields per sound: id, use (when it plays), bus (sfx | weapons | creature | footsteps | ui | ambience), gain (0-1), priority (0-10: who keeps playing when a voice limit is full), maxVoices (copies at once), spatial (placed in 3D around the listener), emitter (where it plays when the caller gives no position: 'leaper' = the Leaper's body, 'leaperEye' = its eye), distance (optional { ref, max, rolloff } in map units), loop, variation (random { pitch, volume } spread per play), variations (the takes: name, files the game loads, source it is built from, credits = keys into sources). An empty variations list is a silent slot: add a take (and its credits) to fill it.

sounds.use: The Leaper fires a laser bolt (from its eye).
A bullet hits the Leaper or any scenery (one shared metal impact, an owner choice).
Loaded for the running footsteps, but not played: sprinting uses the walk recording with faster steps (an owner choice; see assets/audio/FOOTSTEPS.md).
Lola's footsteps (walking, running, sprinting and crouching): single impacts cut from the recording at her animated foot contacts.

build.why: only the ten impacts in the first 5.6 s are played

sounds.use: The Leaper's mechanical footsteps, at each real foot touchdown.

source.notes: Six impacts at 0.78, 1.51, 4.25, 5.03, 6.47 and 7.21 s, each from 70 ms before its peak, 500 ms long with a 25 ms tail fade, in 550 ms slots (see assets/audio/FOOTSTEPS.md).

sounds.use: The M416 reload, started partway into Lola's reload animation so its clicks land on her hands (weapons config reloadSoundAt).
The pistol reload, started partway into Lola's reload animation.
A shot cuts off a piece of a Leaper leg (at the joint).
Pulling the trigger with an empty magazine (both guns).
Lola is hit by a laser bolt (a short pain grunt, one of three takes).
Lola is hit while at low health (a heavier pain cry).
Under every hit Lola takes, beneath the voice (a body thud).

unused.name: scenery-hit
unused.notes: Disabled at the owner's request and not shipped (scenery shares the Leaper impact). Kept as a source only.
